title: Public Alert No. 011/2026 – Alert on the Counterfeit Version of VISITECT HIV Advanced Disease Test Kits Identified in Nigeria

products.manufacturer: AccuBio Ltd, Units 1-12 Hillfoots Business Village Alva, FK 12 5DQ, Scotland, United Kingdom
OMEGA DIAGNOSTICS LTD., Omega House Hillfoots Business Village Alva, FK 12 5DQ, Scotland, United Kingdom

summary: NAFDAC warns of counterfeit/unregistered VISITECT CD4 Advanced Disease HIV test kits in Nigeria. Fakes list OMEGA DIAGNOSTICS LTD as maker, LOT 0001586, no NAFDAC number and a 3-year shelf life (2024-08 to 2027-01), unlike the genuine kit (A3-100-153, LOT 0002172).
